convert_polys_to_mask: create a binary mask from COCO polygon segmentation format given height and width dimensions
flip_segmentation_masks: flip a list of COCO segmentation masks left/right for data augmentation
compute_mask_bounding_box: compute the tight bounding box coordinates from a binary segmentation mask
perform_mask_nms: perform non-maximum suppression on RLE encoded masks using IOU or IOMA overlap measurement
vote_on_rle_masks: combine overlapping RLE masks using weighted average or union voting method
